summary: Fathom Holdings filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting a Second Omnibus Amendment to its Senior Secured Convertible Promissory Notes with two accredited investors. The maturity was extended one month to November 1, 2026; the conversion price was cut from $4.25 to $0.65 per share; interest rose to 18%; and an exchange cap limits note issuances to 19.99% of shares outstanding. A related-party holder is chairman Scott Flanders. No acquisition or tender terms were stated; the filing also notes termination of a prior merger-related agreement. Watch dilution overhang and default risk.
